profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (ticker: ASAN, CIK: 0001477720) founded in 2008. Its platform is designed for teams managing tasks, workflows, and projects, and the company describes its current focus as serving what it calls "human-agent teams," meaning combinations of human workers and AI agents operating within shared workflows.

The company's AI product, tracked here as Asana AI, sits within its broader Agentic Work Management offering, which the site describes as bringing together AI Teammates, AI Studio, Asana Dash, and MCP and AI Connectors. The site explains that AI Teammates use a "shared memory" model, drawing context from something the company calls the Work Graph, so that completed tasks, feedback, and preferences carry forward across workflows. Users can also build custom AI Teammates from their team's existing processes. The product is categorized here under Notes, Knowledge and Meetings, with noted capabilities including goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the company's basic public profile appear in the available data.
